info.name: Purolator Certification REST — Development
info.description:
Purolator REST certification checklist — **Development** (https://shipapi-sandbox.purolator.com).

Generated from samples/index.csv by tooling/build-postman.js — do not edit by hand.

Credentials and account numbers are NOT stored here. Create your own local Postman environment (never committed) with: REST_ClientId, REST_Secret, REST_XApiKey, AccountNumber, Different_AccountNumber, Freight_account.
